name: Rocio Tejerina
bio: Hello! My name is Rocio Tejerina, an International Relation student from Argentina. I have not only been involved in the global non-profit sector, but also worked in the local public sector related to youth initiatives. My professional interest is the human rights field, and I hope that, by joining Pale Blue Dot, I can continue to explore new voices from around the world, and contribute to reaching more people.
funFact: I like to go out to the countryside for breakfast at sunrise in the summer.

name: Azeeza Evelyna
bio: Hi! My name's Azeeza Evelyna, I'm a third-year student at UNC Charlotte studying Political Science and Global Studies, I was born in Seneca, SC, but grew up and was raised in Indonesia! I joined Pale Blue Dot because I wanted to highlight and give recognition to other people's work on an international scale!
